allow: Bash(git -c user.name=AEO -c user.email=dev@aeo.test commit -q -m 'Phase 0: monorepo scaffold, Prisma schema, NestJS auth + RBAC foundation *)
Bash(git -c user.name=AEO -c user.email=dev@aeo.test commit -q -m 'Phase 1: approval engine, mailboxes, contacts/import, templates, campaigns *)
PowerShell(npm run start --workspace apps/web 2>&1 | Out-File -FilePath "$env:TEMP\\aeo_web.log" -Encoding utf8)

PowerShell($ok=$false; for \($i=0; $i -lt 12; $i++\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/login" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 4; if \($r.StatusCode -eq 200\) { $ok=$true; break } } catch {}; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 }; if \($ok\) { "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\); contains title: $\($r.Content -match 'Automated Email Outreach'\)" } else { "server not responding yet" })

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; "stopped web server")
